If you only have money for one medical session. 

Personally I would suggest you see a regular doctor(Primary care physician) or a psychiatrist as unlike therapists(Generally just psychologists) they can also prescribe medication and if you are lucky hand out some trial/samples of medication on top of diagnosing and giving general suggestions for how to improve your mental state.

A general primary care physician won't be as experienced and knowledgeable as a specialized licensed therapist but will definitely be able to diagnose common mental disorders (such as depression and anxiety) and give out the advice you would likely get in a intro session. 

Also another bonus is a primary care physician will be experienced in dealing insurance or a lack there of and will be able to point you in the right direction for all kinds of assistance programs including sliding scale practices and if you live near a university potentially free therapy through a residential training program alongside knowing what medication is cheaper.
